answer: Insured grading makes each grader post a bond against the exact grade it assigns; the bond returns only if that grade sits near the settled consensus. A sybil ring rubber-stamping mirrored copies cannot honor its summit of wagers, because cloned verdicts drift from truth and are slashed at the nadir of consensus. Honest graders post bonds safely and cheaply. Attacker cost: a real, defensible grade backed by collateral per ballot, or capital burned on every wrong stamp.
